steps.instruction: Go to http://127.0.0.1:8069/ and sign in with login 'admin' and password 'admin' if not already signed in. Then in Odoo 17, create a new Contact (customer) named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with the City field set to 'Benchville'. Save it. Verify the record is saved by reopening it and report the customer's name and city as shown on the page. Do not wait for network idle (the app long-polls); wait on concrete page state instead.

recorded.first_line: [FURN_1118] Corner Desk Left Sit, qty 3.00, unit price 85.00, £ 255.00

steps.instruction: In Odoo 17 (already signed in as admin), open the existing draft Quotation {{03-report.quotation}} for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer'. It has two order lines: line 1 is '{{02-report.product}}' quantity {{02-report.quantity}} at £85.00, line 2 is '{{03-report.second_line_product}}' quantity {{03-report.second_line_quantity}} at £33.00; current Untaxed Amount is £321.00. Change ONLY the first line's quantity from 3 to 5 (leave the second line and everything else unchanged). Save, still as a draft (do NOT confirm). Report the new Untaxed Amount the app computes for the whole quotation, and confirm the first line now shows quantity 5. Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state instead.

In Odoo 17 (already signed in as admin), open the existing draft Quotation {{03-report.quotation}} for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (two lines: 'Corner Desk Left Sit' qty 5 at £{{04-open.first_line_unit_price}}, 'Conference Chair (Steel)' qty 2 at £33.00, Untaxed Amount £491.00). Confirm the quotation so it becomes a Sales Order (use the Confirm button / Confirm Sale action). Report: (a) the order reference / name shown for the record (e.g. {{03-report.quotation}}), and (b) the status the app now shows (e.g. 'Sales Order' / 'Sale' in the status bar). Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state instead.

In Odoo 17 (already signed in as admin), open the {{05-open.status}} {{03-report.quotation}} for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (currently confirmed, status '{{05-open.status}}'). Cancel this sales order so nothing stays active — use the Cancel action (it may be under a dropdown menu / 'Action' or a 'Cancel' button; confirm any confirmation dialog that appears). Report the status the app shows after cancelling (e.g. 'Cancelled'). Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state instead.

In Odoo 17 (already signed in as admin), verify two things and report them: (1) Open the contact '{{runid}} Bench Customer' and report its Name and City exactly as shown. (2) Open the sales order {{03-report.quotation}} and report its reference/name, its current status, and whether it is cancelled (not active). Do not modify anything — read only. Do not wait for network idle; wait on concrete page state instead.
